My first semester was harder than I expected. I spent a lot of time trying to understand programming, but eventually the concepts started making sense.
Yesterday I missed the bus by about two minutes and had to wait for the next one. It was annoying at the time, but I reached college without being too late.
I usually prefer studying at night because there are fewer distractions. During the day my phone keeps buzzing and I find myself checking it every few minutes.
The project worked on my laptop but failed when I tried running it on another computer. After checking the configuration for almost an hour, I finally found that one package had a different version.
We visited my grandparents during the holidays. My grandmother made too much food as usual, and everyone ended up eating more than they planned.
I don't really enjoy long meetings. Most of the time the important information could have been explained in a few minutes.
When I started learning Java, I found classes and objects confusing. Writing small programs helped me understand how they actually work.
The weather changed suddenly in the afternoon. It was sunny when I left home, but by the time I returned it had started raining heavily.
I forgot to charge my laptop before leaving for college today. Luckily one of my friends had a charger that was compatible with it.
